text:
Type: low open shelf unit on metal legs
Use: storing books, media and decor, low shelf under a window or TV; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: board with a whitewashed wood-grain foil, aluminium-colored metal legs
Colors: pale whitewashed wood, light beige, silver
Shape: wide low box with four open compartments of different sizes in a staggered layout, thin edges, raised on four slim straight metal legs, light visual weight
Feel: light, airy, orderly, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, white walls, grey textiles, steel accents; Scandinavian or modern living rooms

product.name: VALJE
product.description: An asymmetrical storage solution that becomes personally yours when filled with your belongings.
